kill_clip.name: Kill Clip
kill_clip.description: Reloading after a kill grants +25% damage for a brief window.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: After 12 seconds in continuous combat, +15% damage (also improves handling and reload).

surrounded.name: Surrounded
surrounded.description: +40% damage when 3 or more enemies are within 15m (swords +35%).

explosive_light.name: Explosive Light
explosive_light.description: Orb of Power pickups grant stacks, each shot spends one: grenade launchers +60% explosive damage, rocket launchers +25%.

bait_and_switch.name: Bait and Switch
bait_and_switch.description: Deal damage with all three equipped weapons within a short window to get +30% damage for 10s.

target_lock.name: Target Lock
target_lock.description: Damage ramps with continuous hits up to +40% at max stacks (PvP: 10.5% up to 25%).

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.description: Kills grant a stacking damage bonus: +10% / +21% / +33.1% at ×1 / ×2 / ×3. Stacks expire one at a time.

golden_tricorn.name: Golden Tricorn
golden_tricorn.description: ×2 from a weapon kill of matching element (+15%). ×3 from an ability kill of matching element (+50%).

swashbuckler.name: Swashbuckler
swashbuckler.description: Kills grant stacks (up to ×5): +6.7% damage per stack, +33.3% at max.

adrenaline_junkie.name: Adrenaline Junkie
adrenaline_junkie.description: Kills grant stacks (grenade kills grant all five): +6.7% damage per stack, +33.3% at max, plus 20 Handling.

successful_warm_up.name: Successful Warm-Up
successful_warm_up.description: Weapon kills cut charge / draw time by 37.5% for 6s (it is not a damage buff).

vorpal_weapon.name: Vorpal Weapon
vorpal_weapon.description: More damage to minibosses, bosses, vehicles and Supered Guardians. PvE: primary +20%, special +15%, power +10%. PvP (vs Supers): +60% / +20% / +20%.

firing_line.name: Firing Line
firing_line.description: +20% precision damage when within 15m of two or more allies.

trench_barrel.name: Trench Barrel
trench_barrel.description: After a melee hit, the next 3 shots deal +50% damage with improved handling. Shotgun only.

desperado.name: Desperado
desperado.description: Finishing a reload shortly after a precision kill cuts firing delay by 30% for 7s (it is a rate-of-fire buff, not a damage buff).

high_ground.name: High Ground
high_ground.description: Kills grant stacks (PvP grants two per kill): +10% / +17.5% / +25% damage in PvE, +5% / +10% / +15% in PvP.

killing_tally.name: Killing Tally
killing_tally.description: Kills grant stacking damage: PvE 10 / 20 / 30%, PvP 5 / 10 / 15% at ×1 / ×2 / ×3. Stow or reload removes all stacks.

business_time.name: Business Time
business_time.description: Sweet Business: holding the trigger raises rate of fire by up to 60%.

desperation.name: Desperation
desperation.description: Necrochasm after a Cursed Thrall kill or a precision-kill reload: +20% rate of fire for 7s.

rat_pack.name: Rat Pack
rat_pack.description: Rat King: a stack for each ally within 20m holding Rat King (up to ×5): rate of fire +0 / 13 / 20 / 30 / 40%.

silkbound_slayer.name: Silkbound Slayer
silkbound_slayer.description: Wish-Keeper vs Suspended targets: PvE +125% body / +50% precision damage; PvP +44% body / +20% precision. 30% faster draw.

ignition_trigger.name: Ignition Trigger
ignition_trigger.description: Tommy's Matchbook after 20 rounds in quick succession: +100% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

release_the_wolves.name: Release the Wolves
release_the_wolves.description: Lord of Wolves hip-fire (automatic): +60% rate of fire, +39% body damage and +20% precision damage (bosses +10% body).

one_for_all.name: One For All
one_for_all.description: Hitting 3 different targets in quick succession grants +35% damage for 10.5s.

radiant.name: Radiant
radiant.description: Radiant (Solar, Song of Flame, Facet of Dawn, artifact orbs…): +25% weapon damage in PvE, +10% in PvP.

empowering_rift.name: Empowering Rift
empowering_rift.description: Warlock Empowering Rift: +20% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

weapons_of_light.name: Weapons of Light
weapons_of_light.description: Titan Ward of Dawn: passing through grants +25% weapon damage for 10 seconds (Destinypedia). Bungie publishes no separate Crucible value; Blueberries.gg lists the Helm of Saint-14 version at 25% in both modes, so 25% is used in PvP too.

well_of_radiance.name: Well of Radiance
well_of_radiance.description: Warlock Well of Radiance: +25% weapon damage in PvE and PvP.

banner_shield.name: Banner Shield
banner_shield.description: Void Titan Sentinel Shield: allies shooting through it deal +40% weapon damage in PvE, +35% in PvP.

lumina_noble_rounds.name: Noble Rounds (Lumina)
lumina_noble_rounds.description: Lumina's Noble Rounds grant Blessing of the Sky: +35% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP, for 11s.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.description: Void debuff: weakened targets take +15% damage in PvE, +7.5% in PvP.

tether.name: Shadowshot Tether
tether.description: Void Hunter Shadowshot: tethered targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

divinity.name: Divinity
divinity.description: Divinity: targets in the cage take +15% damage in PvE, +7.5% in PvP.

blessing_of_the_sky.name: Blessing of the Sky
blessing_of_the_sky.description: Noble Rounds (Lumina) or Boots of the Assembler: +35% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

disruption_break.name: Disruption Break
disruption_break.description: Breaking a shield with this weapon makes the target take +50% Kinetic damage for 5.5s. Stacks with every other buff and debuff, Kinetic weapons only.

tractor_cannon_debuff.name: Tractor Cannon
tractor_cannon_debuff.description: Tractor Cannon: hit targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP, for 10s.

worm_byproduct.name: Worm Byproduct
worm_byproduct.description: Wormgod Caress (exotic gauntlets), at max stacks (×5): +35% weapon damage in PvE, +25% in PvP.

spark_of_frequency.name: Spark of Frequency
spark_of_frequency.description: Arc fragment (Clarity): a powered melee hit gives +50 Reload Speed, +15 Stability and a 0.8× reload duration for 5.25 seconds.

amplified.name: Amplified
amplified.description: Arc keyword: +40 Handling and a 0.96× animation scalar to all weapons for 15 seconds (community guides; Bungie does not publish the number). It has no airborne effectiveness bonus.

ember_of_tempering.name: Ember of Tempering
ember_of_tempering.description: Solar fragment. Solar weapon final blows grant Radiant to you and nearby allies. (Activate Radiant above for the damage bonus.)

sever.name: Sever
sever.description: Strand debuff: severed enemies deal reduced damage. It does not increase the damage they take.

whisper_of_hedrons.name: Whisper of Hedrons
whisper_of_hedrons.description: Stasis fragment: freezing a target increases weapon handling and grants health (the Weapon Surge is set under Armor Mods).

thread_of_ascent.name: Thread of Ascent
thread_of_ascent.description: Strand fragment (Clarity): using your grenade ability refills your readied weapon and gives +40 Reload Speed (0.925× reload duration) and +30 Airborne Effectiveness for 15 seconds. A Handling bonus of about +40 is listed but unconfirmed, so it is not applied.

flow_state.name: Flow State
flow_state.description: Arc Hunter aspect (Clarity): while Amplified from killing a Jolted enemy, +50 Reload Speed and a 0.8× reload duration. Amplified itself adds +40 Handling.

on_your_mark.name: On Your Mark
on_your_mark.description: Arc Hunter aspect: class ability or precision hits grant you and nearby allies reload speed and Weapons stat (up to ten stacks).

moebius_quiver.name: Moebius Quiver
moebius_quiver.description: Moebius Quiver tether: tethered targets take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

deadfall.name: Deadfall
deadfall.description: Deadfall tether: enemies in its zone take +30% damage in PvE, +50% in PvP.

heat_rises.name: Heat Rises
heat_rises.description: Solar Warlock aspect (Clarity): passively +20 Airborne Effectiveness, and you can fire while gliding. Not a damage buff.

rally_barricade.name: Rally Barricade
rally_barricade.description: Titan class ability (Clarity): while standing behind the barricade, +100 Reload Speed (0.9× reload duration), +30 Stability, +10% damage falloff distance and 50% flinch resistance.

sentinel_shield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinel_shield.description: Void Titan Sentinel Shield: allies behind it deal +40% weapon damage in PvE, +35% in PvP (same effect as Banner Shield).

helm_of_saint_14.name: Helm of Saint-14
helm_of_saint_14.description: Helm of Saint-14 (exotic helmet): +25% weapon damage for 15s in PvE and PvP.

gyrfalcons_hauberk.name: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk
gyrfalcons_hauberk.description: Gyrfalcon's Hauberk (exotic chest): +35% weapon damage for 6s in PvE; not usable in PvP.

no_backup_plans.name: No Backup Plans
no_backup_plans.description: No Backup Plans (exotic leg armor), shotguns only: +35% damage in PvE, +10% in PvP.

hazardous_propulsion.name: Hazardous Propulsion
hazardous_propulsion.description: Hazardous Propulsion (Clarity): Enhanced Rockets raise rocket-type damage (rocket launchers and Wolfpack Rounds) for 10 seconds: +10 / 17 / 24 / 30 / 33 / 35% at 1 to 6 stacks. Only rocket launchers are affected here, and there is no published PvP value, so none is applied in the Crucible.

prismatic_transfer.name: Prismatic Transfer
prismatic_transfer.description: Prismatic Transfer (artifact): +20% weapon damage in PvE, +15% in PvP.

felwinters_helm.name: Felwinter's Helm
felwinters_helm.description: Felwinter's Helm (exotic helmet): enemies hit by its Void blast take +30% damage for 5-20s.

flash_counter.name: Flash Counter
flash_counter.description: Flash Counter: enemies take +20% damage for 4s.

paracausal_charge.name: Paracausal Charge
paracausal_charge.description: Hawkmoon: each kill or precision hit adds a charge (max 7): +21 / 36.5 / 47.6 / 55.3 / 59.8 / 63.2 / 66.3% damage against combatants, none against Guardians. "Last ×N" is the final round of the magazine, Paracausal Shot, whose bonus replaces the charge bonus (PvE +292% up to +1736%, PvP +30% up to +508.6%). Pick it to see that one shot; DPS still assumes every shot gets the bonus.

death_at_first_glance.name: Death at First Glance
death_at_first_glance.description: Eriana's Vow: while aiming down sights, +32.5% damage as long as you land precision hits or damage a combatant shield.

lightning_rounds.name: Lightning Rounds
lightning_rounds.description: Thunderlord: holding the trigger gives 0.75× fire recovery delay after 13 shots and 0.6× after 26.

impetus.name: Impetus
impetus.description: Merciless: finishing a reload 6 seconds after a kill gives +50% damage for 4.5 seconds.

superconductor.name: Superconductor
superconductor.description: Riskrunner: while Arc Conductor is active, +10% damage.

swooping_talons.name: Swooping Talons
swooping_talons.description: The Manticore: while airborne each hit adds +10% damage (PvP +2%), up to ×10 (+100% / +20%). Resets on landing.

bullseye_bolster.name: Bullseye Bolster
bullseye_bolster.description: New Land Beyond: precision hits give +5% rate of fire for 3 seconds (lost on a miss or body shot).

string_of_curses.name: String of Curses
string_of_curses.description: Bad Juju: each kill adds a stack for 5.5 seconds (max 5): +20 / 40 / 60 / 80 / 100% damage in PvE, +10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50% in PvP.

ravenous_beast.name: Unleash the Beast
ravenous_beast.description: Tarrabah, while unleashed (8 seconds): +187% body-shot and +99% precision damage in PvE (+120% / +52.7% in PvP), and 0.8× fire recovery delay.

fan_fire.name: Fan Fire
fan_fire.description: The Last Word: hip-fired precision hits deal +88% damage in PvE. The PvP value isn't published, so none is applied in the Crucible.

cranial_spike.name: Cranial Spike
cranial_spike.description: Dead Man's Tale: each precision hit adds a stack for 4 seconds (max 5): +3.4 / 6.8 / 10.2 / 13.6 / 17% damage against combatants. No effect on Guardians.

parasitism.name: Parasitism
parasitism.description: Outbreak Perfected: damage against targets carrying SIVA nanites, per nanite (1-5): +30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150% in PvE, +15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75% in PvP. Beyond five, +2.1% per nanite.

catalyst_mythoclast_surge.name: Mythoclast Surge
catalyst_mythoclast_surge.description: Vex Mythoclast catalyst, Auto Rifle mode: landing 15 hits within 3 seconds, or a kill, gives +20% damage for 5 seconds.

catalyst_will_given_form.name: Will Given Form
catalyst_will_given_form.description: Ager's Scepter catalyst: +80% damage while the super-energy drain lasts. The Crucible value isn't published, so none is applied there.

catalyst_cerberus_kill.name: Cerberus Kill Boost
catalyst_cerberus_kill.description: Cerberus+1 catalyst: holding reload within 7 seconds of a kill gives +50% damage for 7 seconds (+10% in PvP).

catalyst_divinity_precision.name: Divinity Precision Buff
catalyst_divinity_precision.description: Divinity catalyst: 68 precision hits give +25% damage for 11 seconds.

catalyst_necrochasm_triple.name: Necrochasm Triple Hit
catalyst_necrochasm_triple.description: Necrochasm catalyst: damaging 3 enemies within 3 seconds gives +35% damage for 10 seconds.

catalyst_devils_ruin_pickup.name: Devil's Ruin Pickup
catalyst_devils_ruin_pickup.description: Devil's Ruin catalyst: elemental pickups give +30% damage (+10% in PvP) for 4 to 8 seconds.

catalyst_whispered_breathing.name: Whispered Breathing
catalyst_whispered_breathing.description: Whisper of the Worm catalyst: after 1.2 seconds aiming without firing, +35% precision damage and, in PvE, +10.777% damage against combatants.

honed_edge.name: Honed Edge
honed_edge.description: Izanagi's Burden: hold reload to spend ammo for one boosted shot. 2 / 3 / 4 stacks give +12 / 25 / 112% body-shot and +79 / 131 / 291% precision damage in PvE (+20 / 45 / 165% and +91 / 167 / 389% in PvP). Only that one shot is boosted; the calculator applies it to every shot.

memento_mori.name: Memento Mori
memento_mori.description: Ace of Spades: finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill gives the next 6 shots +68% damage in PvE (+29% in PvP).

markov_chain.name: Markov Chain
markov_chain.description: Monte Carlo: each weapon kill adds a stack for 4.5 seconds (max 5): +13 / 26 / 39 / 52 / 65% damage in PvE (+6.6 / 13.2 / 19.8 / 26.4 / 33% in PvP). Melee kills while holding it grant all five.

harmonic_laser.name: Harmonic Laser
harmonic_laser.description: Wavesplitter: holding the trigger cycles the beam through Low, Medium and High power. Medium adds 32.2% damage and High 68.7% in PvE (3% and 6.25% in PvP).

cold_fusion.name: Cold Fusion
cold_fusion.description: Coldheart: damage rises linearly up to +80% as the beam charges to full power (dealing damage and collecting Ionic Traces charge it).

the_fundamentals.name: The Fundamentals
the_fundamentals.description: Borealis and Hard Light: +30% damage for 10 seconds after receiving or applying an elemental buff or debuff that matches the selected element (+10% in PvP).

ionic_return.name: Ionic Return
ionic_return.description: Borealis: breaking a matching elemental shield grants 5 shots with +15% body-shot and +37% critical damage.

volatile_light.name: Volatile Light
volatile_light.description: Hard Light: bullets that have ricocheted deal +100% damage in PvE (+35% in PvP).

paracausal_imbuement.name: Paracausal Imbuement
paracausal_imbuement.description: Microcosm: +20% damage for 20 seconds once your Super energy reaches 0%.

saints_fury.name: Saint's Fury
saints_fury.description: Bastion: melee damage grants 8.5 seconds of +35% weapon damage and 15% shorter charge time.

inverse_relationship.name: Inverse Relationship
inverse_relationship.description: Red Death Reformed: damage rises as your shield is depleted, +10 / 20 / 40% in PvE (+2 / 4 / 6% in PvP) below 114 / 60 / 0 shield HP.

the_roadborn.name: Roadborn
the_roadborn.description: The Chaperone: a precision kill (or two precision hits) gives 10 seconds of +22% precision damage and +42% rate of fire.

hail_storm.name: Hail Storm
hail_storm.description: Verglas Curve: +50% damage against Frozen enemies and Stasis Crystals.

phase_converter.name: Phase Converter
phase_converter.description: Lodestar: while aiming down sights, +30% damage to Arc-debuffed targets.

tempest_cascade.name: Tempest Cascade
tempest_cascade.description: Delicate Tomb: collecting an Ionic Trace gives the next shot +100% damage in PvE (+7% in PvP) and applies Jolt. The calculator applies it to every shot.

nightsworn_sight.name: Nightsworn Sight
nightsworn_sight.description: Slayer's Fang: a kill or Void Breach pickup grants Nightsworn Sight for 7 seconds, +15% precision damage (also +10% against Fallen and Scorn, not modelled).

on_black_wings.name: On Black Wings
on_black_wings.description: Duality: a pellet kill or 10 pellet hits grants a stack for 10 seconds (max 3). Pellet precision damage +3.5 / 8.8 / 12.4%; slug precision damage +15.6 / 39 / 54.7% (the calculator uses the pellet numbers).

the_right_choice.name: The Right Choice
the_right_choice.description: Khvostov 7G-0X: every 7th shot in the magazine deals +252.52% damage in PvE (+5% in PvP) and ricochets. Shown as the average over seven shots, since the calculator has no per-shot sequence.
